embeds.description:
This channel serves as a direct but private link between **You** and the **Officer Team**!

*If you have any questions, feedback, something to discuss or just to vent, feel free to message us here!*

## Important links and documents:
<#1402930215163920405> - WeakAuras and other things related to raiding.
<#1370832674360528976> This is where we post the rosters and roster changes.

[**Absence form**](<{{absenceForm}}>) - Use this to give us a heads up if you can't make it to any of the raids in the future. Please try to give us notice in advance so we can plan ahead. 
[**Consumable request form**](<{{consumableRequestForm}}>) - You can request food, flasks, potions and enchants by using this form. 
[**Raid assignments**](<{{raidAssignments}}>) - This spreadsheet serves as the guild assignment panel. You can see what jobs you are required to do, general positions in the raids and other useful information. 

[**Thatsmybis**](<{{thatsMyBis}}>) - Please log in with Discord and join Drumroll on TMB. After joining, make sure you create your character. Once you have a character in the guild, please make a wishlist with your BiS items and provide useful information such as upgrade values (use [wowsims](<{{wowSims}}>)) about certain pieces in notes. This helps us determine loot priorities and track loot in general.
